integrity: The proof derives the four gcd-class adjacency pattern directly from p- and q-adic divisibility, then proves that at most one white vertex per twin class is both necessary and sufficient for zero forcing. The rank upper bound is an explicit four-by-four nonsingular block witness, and the standard maximum-nullity inequality proves optimality.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to standard zero-divisor graphs of integer residue rings with modulus p^2 q for distinct primes.
The four-class structural decomposition is prior work.
Generic twin-type compression is broader prior coverage; novelty is restricted to the closed arithmetic forcing polynomial, minimizer classification, and exact real minimum rank.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and minimum rank of two-prime-square residue-ring zero-divisor graphs
